advancementsmod.explain.adventure.advent: Visit every Overworld biome at least once. The list below shows which ones you are still missing.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.arbali: Kill five different kinds of mobs with a single crossbow shot. A Piercing crossbow and mobs lined up in a trap make it possible.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.avoid_: Sneak past a Sculk Sensor or a Warden so it does not hear you.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.blowba: Kill a Breeze with one of its own Wind Charges: hit the charge back at it.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.brush_: Use a Brush on an Armadillo to get Armadillo Scutes.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.bullse: Hit the very center of a Target block with an arrow from at least 30 blocks away.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.craft_: Craft a Decorated Pot from 4 Pottery Sherds (no bricks) in a diamond shape. Sherds come from brushing Suspicious Sand and Gravel.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.crafte: Stand next to a Crafter while it crafts another Crafter: give it the Crafter recipe items and power it with redstone.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.fall_f: Fall from the top of the world (Y 319) all the way down to the bottom (below Y -59) and survive. Land in water, use a Slow Falling potion or a Totem of Undying.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.heart_: Place a Creaking Heart between two Pale Oak Logs, all facing the same way (logs above and below the heart).
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.hero_o: Win a raid: enter a village with Bad Omen and defeat every wave of Pillagers.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.honey_: Jump against the side of a Honey Block so you slide down it slowly.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.kill_a: Kill one of every hostile mob type. The list below shows which ones you are still missing.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.kill_m: Kill any mob next to a Sculk Catalyst (found in the Deep Dark) so the sculk spreads.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.lighte: Use an axe on an oxidized (exposed, weathered or oxidized) Copper Bulb that is turned on, to scrape it and make it brighter.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.lightn: Place a Lightning Rod near a Villager. When lightning hits the rod during a thunderstorm and nothing catches fire, you get it.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.minecr: Find a Trial Chamber underground (copper and tuff rooms) and step inside.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.ol_bet: Craft a Crossbow and shoot it.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.overov: Deal 50 hearts of damage in one Mace smash: fall from very high (or use Wind Charges) and hit a mob with a Mace, ideally enchanted with Density.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.play_j: Place a Jukebox in a Meadow biome and play any music disc in it.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.read_p: Place a Chiseled Bookshelf with at least one book and a Comparator reading from it.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.revaul: Unlock an Ominous Vault with an Ominous Trial Key, from a Trial Chamber under the Trial Omen effect.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.root: Kill any mob, or get killed by something.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.salvag: Brush Suspicious Sand or Gravel in desert temples, desert wells, ocean ruins or trail ruins until you get a Pottery Sherd.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.shoot_: Hit any mob with an arrow from a bow or crossbow.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.sleep_: Sleep in a bed to set your respawn point.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.sniper: Kill a Skeleton with an arrow from at least 50 blocks away.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.spear_: Hit five mobs with one charge attack of a Spear: hold use to charge and run through a group.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.spygla: Look at the Ender Dragon through a Spyglass.
Look at a Ghast in the Nether through a Spyglass.
Craft a Spyglass (copper and amethyst) and look at a Parrot through it. Parrots live in jungles.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.summon: Build an Iron Golem: 4 iron blocks in a T shape with a carved pumpkin on top.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.throw_: Throw a Trident at any mob. Tridents drop from Drowned.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.totem_: Die while holding a Totem of Undying (dropped by Evokers in raids and woodland mansions).
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.trade_: Bring a Villager up to the build limit (Y 319) and trade with it there.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.trim_w: Use each of these armor trim templates at least once: Spire, Snout, Rib, Ward, Silence, Vex, Tide and Wayfinder. They come from End Cities, Bastions, Nether Fortresses, Ancient Cities, Woodland Mansions, Ocean Monuments and Trail Ruins.
Use any armor trim smithing template on a piece of armor at a Smithing Table.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.two_bi: Kill two Phantoms with one arrow from a crossbow enchanted with Piercing.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.under_: Unlock a Vault in a Trial Chamber with a Trial Key.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.use_lo: Place a Lodestone and right-click it with a Compass. The compass then points to it, even in the Nether.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.very_v: Hit a Villager with lightning: throw a Trident with Channeling at it during a thunderstorm.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.volunt: Kill a raid captain: a Pillager or Vindicator carrying a banner. Careful, it gives you Bad Omen.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.walk_o: Wear leather boots and walk on Powder Snow without sinking. Powder snow is found in snowy slopes and groves.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.who_ne: Use a Wind Charge (from Breezes in Trial Chambers) to launch yourself about 8 blocks up. Throw it at your feet and jump.
advancementsmod.explain.adventure.whos_t: Kill a Pillager with a crossbow.
advancementsmod.explain.end.dragon_breat: During the dragon fight, right-click its purple breath clouds with an empty Glass Bottle.
advancementsmod.explain.end.dragon_egg: Get the Dragon Egg into your inventory. It sits on the exit portal; push it with a piston or let it fall onto a torch so it drops as an item.
advancementsmod.explain.end.elytra: Find an End Ship next to an End City and take the Elytra from the item frame inside.
advancementsmod.explain.end.enter_end_ga: After the dragon dies, throw an Ender Pearl into a small End Gateway portal at the edge of the main island.
advancementsmod.explain.end.find_end_cit: Go through an End Gateway to the outer islands and walk into an End City.
advancementsmod.explain.end.kill_dragon: Destroy the End Crystals on the obsidian pillars, then kill the Ender Dragon.
advancementsmod.explain.end.levitate: Get hit by Shulker bullets in an End City until the Levitation lifts you 50 blocks up.
advancementsmod.explain.end.respawn_drag: Place 4 End Crystals on the edges of the exit portal (one per side) to bring the dragon back.
advancementsmod.explain.end.root: Enter the End through the End portal in a stronghold.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.allay_: Give an Allay a Cake and play a Note Block near it. The Allay drops a cake at the note block.
Give an Allay an item. It will collect matching items and bring them to you. Allays are found in Pillager Outposts and Woodland Mansions.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.axolot: Right-click an Axolotl with a Water Bucket. Axolotls live in Lush Caves.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.balanc: Eat every food in the game at least once, including the odd ones like Rotten Flesh, Spider Eye, Poisonous Potato, Pufferfish and Chorus Fruit. The list below shows which ones you are still missing.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.bred_a: Breed every animal that can be bred. The list below shows which ones you are still missing.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.breed_: Feed two animals of the same kind their favorite food (wheat for cows and sheep, carrots for pigs, seeds for chickens) so they breed.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.comple: Tame one cat of every variant with raw cod or salmon. Stray cats are in villages, black cats in swamp huts. The list below shows which ones you are still missing.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.feed_s: Feed a baby Sniffer (Snifflet) Torchflower Seeds.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.fishy_: Catch any fish with a fishing rod.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.frogli: Have all three Froglights at once: let frogs of each color eat small Magma Cubes in the Nether.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.kill_a: Fight next to an Axolotl: when it kills a mob that you hurt, it gives you Regeneration.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.leash_: Put a lead on each of the three frog variants: temperate (orange), cold (green) and warm (white). Frogs get their color from the biome the tadpole grows up in.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.make_a: Use a Glow Ink Sac on a sign that has text on it.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.obtain: Upgrade a diamond hoe with a netherite ingot at a Smithing Table.
Get a Sniffer Egg: brush Suspicious Sand in warm ocean ruins, or breed two Sniffers.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.place_: Place a Dried Ghast block in water so it is waterlogged. Dried Ghasts are found in Soul Sand Valleys.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.plant_: Plant a Torchflower Seed or a Pitcher Pod. Sniffers dig them up.
Plant any seed: wheat seeds, beetroot, melon or pumpkin seeds, nether wart, torchflower or pitcher pod.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.remove: Use Shears on a tamed wolf wearing Wolf Armor.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.repair: Right-click a tamed wolf wearing damaged Wolf Armor with Armadillo Scutes until the armor is fully repaired.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.ride_a: Get a Goat into a boat (push it in or lead it there) and then get in the same boat yourself.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.safely: Put a Campfire below a full Beehive or Bee Nest, then right-click the hive with a Glass Bottle. The smoke keeps the bees calm.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.silk_t: Break a Bee Nest or Beehive with 3 bees inside using a Silk Touch tool, then place it somewhere else.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.tactic: Catch a fish with a Water Bucket: right-click a cod, salmon, pufferfish or tropical fish in the water.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.tadpol: Right-click a Tadpole with a Water Bucket. Tadpoles hatch from frogspawn in swamps.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.tame_a: Tame any animal: a wolf with bones, a cat with raw fish, a horse by riding it, a parrot with seeds.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.uh_oh: Give an adult Sulfur Cube a TNT block (right-click it with TNT), or drop TNT next to it so it picks it up.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.wax_of: Use an axe on a waxed copper block to remove the wax.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.wax_on: Use Honeycomb on any copper block to wax it.
advancementsmod.explain.husbandry.whole_: Tame one wolf of every variant with bones. Each variant lives in a different biome (taiga, forests, savanna, badlands and more). The list below shows which ones you are still missing.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.all_effec: Have every status effect at the same time, including ones from mobs, raids and conduits. This one is practically only possible with commands or a big redstone setup.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.all_potio: Have all of these at once: Fire Resistance, Infested, Invisibility, Jump Boost, Night Vision, Oozing, Poison, Regeneration, Resistance, Slow Falling, Slowness, Speed, Strength, Water Breathing, Weakness, Weaving and Wind Charged. Drink long-lasting versions quickly one after another.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.brew_poti: Craft a Brewing Stand (blaze rod and cobblestone), add Blaze Powder as fuel and brew any potion, for example a Nether Wart into water bottles.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.charge_re: Place a Respawn Anchor and right-click it with glowstone until it is fully charged (4 charges).
advancementsmod.explain.nether.create_be: Craft a Beacon (Nether Star from the Wither, glass and obsidian) and place it.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.create_fu: Put a Beacon on a full 4-level pyramid of iron, gold, emerald, diamond or netherite blocks (164 blocks).
advancementsmod.explain.nether.distract_: Throw a gold ingot (or other gold item) to a Piglin that would attack you. Wear a piece of gold armor so it stays calm.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.explore_n: Visit all five Nether biomes: Nether Wastes, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Soul Sand Valley and Basalt Deltas.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.fast_trav: Travel 7,000 blocks in the Nether, measured the way it counts in the Overworld (1 Nether block = 8 Overworld blocks), then use a portal back. Going about 875 blocks in a straight line in the Nether is enough.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.find_bast: Find a Bastion Remnant (large blackstone ruins full of Piglins) and walk inside.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.find_fort: Find a Nether Fortress (dark red Nether brick bridges and halls) and walk inside.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.get_withe: Kill Wither Skeletons in a Nether Fortress until one drops its skull. Looting raises the chance.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.loot_bast: Open a loot chest inside a Bastion Remnant.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.netherite: Have a full set of netherite armor: upgrade all 4 diamond pieces with netherite ingots at a Smithing Table (each needs a Netherite Upgrade template).
advancementsmod.explain.nether.obtain_an: Mine Ancient Debris with a diamond or netherite pickaxe. It is most common around Y 15 in the Nether; beds or TNT blow up the netherrack around it quickly.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.obtain_bl: Kill a Blaze, found near spawners in Nether Fortresses, until it drops a Blaze Rod.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.obtain_cr: Get Crying Obsidian: trade gold with Piglins, loot it from chests in Bastion Remnants or ruined portals.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.return_to: Kill a Ghast with its own fireball: hit the fireball back at it with your hand, a weapon or an arrow.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.ride_stri: Put a saddle on a Strider and ride it while holding a Warped Fungus on a Stick to steer it.
Bring a Strider to the Overworld and ride it for a long way (about 50 blocks) across a lava lake.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.root: Enter the Nether through a Nether portal.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.summon_wi: Place 4 soul sand or soul soil in a T shape and put 3 Wither Skeleton skulls on top. Do it somewhere safe: the Wither destroys blocks.
advancementsmod.explain.nether.uneasy_al: Lure or carry a Ghast through a Nether portal into the Overworld and kill it there. Trapping it in a boat or with a lead in the portal works best.
advancementsmod.explain.story.cure_zombi: Hit a Zombie Villager with a Splash Potion of Weakness, then right-click it with a Golden Apple. Keep it out of the sun for the few minutes it takes to cure.
advancementsmod.explain.story.deflect_ar: Hold a shield in your offhand, hold right-click to raise it and block an arrow or other projectile. Skeletons are the easiest target.
advancementsmod.explain.story.enchant_it: Craft an Enchanting Table (book, 2 diamonds, 4 obsidian), put an item and lapis lazuli in it and pick an enchantment.
advancementsmod.explain.story.enter_the_: Find the End portal room in a stronghold, fill all 12 frames with Eyes of Ender and jump in.
Build a frame of obsidian (at least 4 wide and 5 tall), light the inside with flint and steel and walk through.
advancementsmod.explain.story.follow_end: Throw Eyes of Ender (right-click) and follow them to a stronghold. You get this once you are inside it.
advancementsmod.explain.story.form_obsid: Get a block of obsidian into your inventory. Pour water onto still lava to make it, then mine it with a diamond pickaxe.
advancementsmod.explain.story.iron_tools: Craft an iron pickaxe: 3 iron ingots on top, 2 sticks below.
advancementsmod.explain.story.lava_bucke: Craft a bucket from 3 iron ingots and right-click a lava source block with it.
advancementsmod.explain.story.mine_diamo: Find diamond ore, most common deep down near Y -59, and mine it with an iron pickaxe.
advancementsmod.explain.story.mine_stone: Mine stone with a wooden pickaxe so you get cobblestone (or cobbled deepslate or blackstone) in your inventory.
advancementsmod.explain.story.obtain_arm: Craft any one piece of iron armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots) from iron ingots.
advancementsmod.explain.story.root: Craft a Crafting Table from 4 planks. Having one in your inventory is enough.
advancementsmod.explain.story.shiny_gear: Craft any one piece of diamond armor.
advancementsmod.explain.story.smelt_iron: Mine iron ore with a stone pickaxe, put the raw iron in a furnace with fuel and take out an iron ingot.
advancementsmod.explain.story.upgrade_to: Craft a stone pickaxe: 3 cobblestone on top, 2 sticks below, at a Crafting Table.
